# Completion Report: Work Order 6 — MCP Pull Tools

## Summary of Changes

Implemented the 5 MCP server pull tools and note capture tool within [`internal/mcpserver`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver):

1. **Tool Definitions & Request/Response Types ([`tools.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go)):**
   - [`HandleMemoryBrief`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L88): Resolves aliases via `index.ResolveAlias`, retrieves entries for scope, filters out retired/superseded items, formats scope header, entry count, and entries as `[<type>] <id>: <text>` (truncated to 200 chars), recording pulls in the ledger.
   - [`HandleMemoryWhy`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L139): Retrieves entry and historical versions via `index.GetEntry` and `index.GetHistory`, formatting entry type, text, anchors, evidence, verification status, created/updated timestamps, and history records, recording pull in the ledger.
   - [`HandleMemoryHistory`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L227): Resolves alias, queries entries and `entry_history` for scope, filters to retired/superseded entries, formats ID, type, text, retired reason and superseded-by, recording pulls in the ledger.
   - [`HandleMemorySearch`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L330): Executes FTS5 BM25 search via `index.SearchEntries`, limits results to top 10, formats ranked list with 100-char snippets, recording pulls in the ledger.
   - [`HandleMemoryNote`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L365): Validates scope, text, and entry type (defaulting to `"decision"`), generates typed ID (e.g., `dec-...`), writes an `OpAdd` operation batch with `source: "agent"` to the ops directory via `ops.Writer`, and returns `"Note recorded: <entryID>"`.

2. **Server Updates & Registration ([`server.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/server.go)):**
   - Updated [`Server`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L13-L17) to support optional `ledger *delivery.Ledger` and `opsWriter *ops.Writer`.
   - Added `WithLedger`, `WithOpsWriter`, and `WithOpsDir` options to `NewServer`.
   - Added `RegisteredTools()` and dynamic `CallTool()` dispatcher for tool dispatch by name.
   - Deprecated `HandleMemoryAsk`, `MemoryAskRequest`, and `MemoryAskResponse` while preserving backwards compatibility.

3. **Test Suite ([`tools_test.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.V8jNUdNtzz/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go)):**
   - Added unit and integration tests covering `memory.brief`, `memory.why`, `memory.history`, `memory.search`, `memory.note`, alias resolution, ledger pull exposure recording, default options, and `CallTool` dispatch.
